behavior: Mark an existing order as delivered and publish an order-delivered integration event.
domainModelNotes: The application layer loads the target order by id.
If the order does not exist, the current implementation throws KeyNotFoundException.
constructorPostconditions: If current status is not Delivered, status becomes Delivered and the reason is carried in domain and integration events.
If current status is already Delivered, no event, persistence, or integration event occurs.
The integration event is staged atomically with the event stream and read model.
